consequence.statement: Changes to fields covered by system-level ignoreDifferences customizations no longer trigger a diff/refresh for the application, unlike the v2 default.
consequence.remediation: Set ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates to false in argocd-cm resource.compareoptions to preserve v2 behavior.

assertion.statement: In 3.0 the system-level ignoreDifferences customizations also apply to ignoring resource updates by default (ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates now true); set it to false in argocd-cm resource.compareoptions to keep the v2 behavior.
